steps.instruction: Confirm all declared writers are quiesced and record the external checkpoint.
preconditions: operator has reviewed the final backup report

stopConditions: any node reports an unexpected writer
observations: all old nodes report powered off

stopConditions: new control plane does not report healthy
observations: new etcd and Kubernetes API are healthy

stopConditions: Flux source is not at the pinned recovery commit

steps.instruction: Restore the pinned Longhorn and CNPG sources in bounded waves and attach receipts.
stopConditions: a source digest differs from the checkpoint
observations: all required restore receipts are artifact-verified

steps.instruction: Enable only consumers whose restore receipt and semantic check passed.
stopConditions: a consumer lacks a functional receipt

steps.instruction: Retire the explicitly listed old disks after acceptance and retention review.
stopConditions: any target is not an explicitly reviewed disk
observations: operator records each target and its retirement receipt

confirmation.prompt: Retire only the listed old disks; this is irreversible.
confirmation.acknowledgeWith: I confirm the listed disk targets and understand the irreversible data-loss boundary.
